sources.title: Simunek and Bek2003: Noeggerathiaceae from the Carboniferous basins of the Bohemian Massif
sources.notes: Primary full paper text read through publicly indexed author-uploaded ResearchGate version. Original inventory2015 Elsevier item unavailable and replaced transparently. Direct2003 PDF download403; original2003 detailed margin plate pixels NOT obtained. Text supports obovate-obcuneate pinnules, shallow dentate or lobed distal edges and fan dichotomous venation; small basal pairs and narrowing apex. Full frond50-60cm is authors reconstruction. Actual holotype plate supplied by National Museum2021 source below. No cuticle anatomy modeled.
sources.rights_note: Consult-only research. Copyright retained by original authors/institution; no source pixels, text blocks, textures, scans or meshes incorporated or redistributed in public Git. No redistribution license asserted.
sources.actual_reference_pixels_inspected: Author Fig11 whole reconstruction personally viewed via attributed teaching-page reproduction; it supports overall frond arrangement only, NOT fine leaf-end details. Fine teeth follow primary text, with holotype pixel resolution limitation explicitly retained.

sources.title: Kvacek, Daskova and Libertin2021: Catalogue of Plant Fossils Described in Works by Kaspar M. Sternberg, Second Revised Edition
sources.notes: Primary museum catalogue, printedp102 and Plate22 printedp260, NM-E122a holotype Noeggerathia foliosa. Original fossil photo inspected. It confirms broad attached wedge-obovate pinnules and tapering rachis; fine marginal denticles are not reliably resolved in this photograph, so conservative shallow dentition follows2003 text rather than claimed measured holotype teeth. Other species on plate explicitly excluded.
